progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk3 and dwells most on D# in Kereshme Ba Muye. The line peaks at Cs5 (546.0 Hz) at 1:10.8. It closes on the tonic (D#4 → E4 → Gk4 → D#4 → D#4 → B3).
